title: console(nav): drag-to-reorder is wired only for group-free navigation — every stock app's sidebar is grouped, so enableReorder never renders a grip
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 · platform-core.shell-nav-personalization · acceptance[2]

Clause A3 of `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF4, RUNNER rule 7; code at the pin) confirmed it: P3 (product gap). It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui.

## Reproduction

1. Stock showcase boot, admin form sign-in.
2. Server truth: `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=showcase_app`. The navigation carries groups (8), as do Setup and Account.
3. Browser: open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task` and hover or try to drag any sidebar entry.
4. Expected: a drag grip, and the new order restored after reload (localStorage `objectui-nav-order-showcase_app`).
5. Actual: 0 `[aria-label="Drag to reorder"]`, no sortable, and the key is never written. Seen on two loads.

## Mechanism

- `NavigationRenderer.tsx:1590` computes `hasGroups`.
- The DndContext / SortableNavigationItem path exists only in the `if (!hasGroups)` arm (`:1614-1631`). The grouped arm (`:1650` ff.) renders plain `NavigationItemRenderer`.
- `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:583` passes `enableReorder={!isMobile}` unconditionally.
- `useNavOrder` (`:76-110`) persists only `__root__`.
- The prop doc (`:224`, "Enable drag-to-reorder for navigation items") states no flat-only limit.
- The code is identical at `31971ff1e`. No open duplicate.

## Done when

Reorder works on grouped navigation (within or across groups), or the maintainers rule flat-only and the prop doc and checklist clause say so.
